player_prompt.intro:
A nyi azɔ Player {player_id} to Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma tọn he na wazọ́n to {num_rounds} whenu lẹ mẹ.

Nuhe gando oyọnẹn lẹ go:
- Jẹnukọn whẹndo kande, a na wazọ́n {total_conversation_rounds} whẹndo nado dọhó bo gbọn.
- Gbọnmẹ, omẹ awe lẹ na wazọ́n nado dè to Cooperate kavi Defect mẹ.

Payoff Matrix (he ma gble to whenu kọmẹ):
- Omẹ awe lẹ Cooperate ➜ omẹ awe lẹ {cooperate_reward}
- Omẹ awe lẹ Defect ➜ omẹ awe lẹ {mutual_defect_reward}
- Omẹ dopo Defects, omẹ dopo Cooperates ➜ Defector {defect_reward}, Cooperator {sucker_reward}

Nuhe gando dọhó lẹ go:
- To whenu dọhó tọn: dọ nuhe a jlo.
- To whenu kande tọn: de '[Cooperate]' kavi '[Defect]' (he ma gble to kọdetọn mẹ). A sọgan dọ nuhe a jlo whẹnukọn/podo token lọ.

phases.conversation_finished: Gbɛtɔ gbɛtɔa ɖo tɔn {round} tọn. Balo nu tɔn '[Cooperate]' kavi '[Defect]' le \boxed{{}} mẹ.

outcome.draw: Wẹkẹ de! Omẹ awe lẹ mọ {s0}.
outcome.round_both_cooperate: Azɔ̌watɔ́ we lɛ bǐ wà nǔ ɖó kpɔ́.
outcome.round_both_defect: Azɔ̌watɔ́ we lɛ bǐ wɛ hɔn.
outcome.round_p0_cooperates_p1_defects: Azɔwatɔ́ 0 wà azɔ̌ ɖó kpɔ́, bɔ mɛ 1 lɛ̀ jó gbè.
outcome.round_p0_defects_p1_cooperates: Azɔwatɔ́ 0 jó gbè, bɔ mɛ 1 nɔ wà azɔ̌ ɖó kpɔ́.
